summary: test_argv_resume_reads_only_the_first_line_of_each_rollout wraps Path.open with a byte-accounting proxy that raises once reads exceed the first line's length and appends 5000 garbage lines; the production scan uses path.open()+readline(), so read_text()/read()/readlines()/full iteration are all intercepted and rejected (builtin open() would evade the wrapper, but is not the code path).
